svg.title: How Beryl is checked
svg.desc: x509-limbo: 9,795 cases run, every one matches its expected result. Differential against OpenSSL: 0 mismatches over 1,000,000 X25519 cases and 200,000 cases each for P-256, P-384 and Ed25519. Timing: the dudect statistic stays below 4.5 over 1,000,000 measurements per class for the curve operations on the build Mac. Fuzzing: 0 findings in 10,000,000 mutated DER inputs run through every certificate reader.
